reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

title.narrative: EU-Kiribati Partnership - Safe and sustainable drinking water for Kiritimati Island - SPC

description.narrative: This Action is part of the larger programme: EU-Kiribati Partnership for a sustainable and inclusive socio-economic development. The overall objective is to support Kiribati in building greater socio-economic and climate resilience. The Specific objective is to improve the use of services and goods provided by the public sector with a focus on water and sanitation in the Line Islands. This CA covers 1 out of 4 components of the broader Partnership:Component 2 Safe and sustainable drinking waterExpected results for the SPC components:1. Improved evidence-based management of water resources; 2. Increased access to safe and reliable drinking water supply; and3. Strengthened capacity to operate, maintain and manage safe efficient and accountable water supply systems.

comment.narrative: Not implemented under review

title.narrative: Status of implementation of the Sustainable Water Management Plan for Kiritimati

description.narrative: Status of implementation of the Sustainable Water Management Plan for Kiritimati

comment.narrative: Not implemented under revision
WMP utilised by Government as a framework to facilitate the provision of a safe continuous reliable and efficient supply of water to households on Kiritimati Island.

Ongoing application and planned update. SWMP used as reference document to develop concept and detailed designs and Action scope. Further application of the plan throughout detailed design and utility capacity building activities. WMP will be updated to incorporate and strengthen longerterm water supply alternatives with consideration given to the viability of desalination and rainwater especially once sustainable and economically viable groundwater options near maximum sustainable utilisation.
